next.reason: 1985: min/max record sizes 'are established at the time the file is created and must not subsequently be changed'. 2023 §2023:9.1.6 (prose, no catalog rule) lists 'the minimum and maximum logical record size in bytes' among attributes that 'apply to the file at the time it is created and cannot be changed'; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR10 enforces them at OPEN by comparing the connector's attributes 'with the fixed file attributes of the file' (status 39, as 1985 status 39 in §1985:VIII.1.3.4). Same requirement.
